messages:
Alex (PM): Heads-up: Q3 compliance planning — we need to pick priorities between 1) per-tenant audit log retention/export, 2) KMS/HSM onboarding + rotation automation, 3) SOC2 evidence ingestion automation. Constraint: 2 engineers + 1 SRE for the quarter. Want LAUNCH CRITERIA for each and risk/cost notes. Thoughts? cc @Maria (Security) @Devin (SRE)
Maria (Security): For SOC2 customers, HSM/KMS onboarding is high-impact. Minimum acceptance: HSM-backed key storage, rotation events in audit log, and a signed proof artifact. Main risk: vendor integration slowness + compliance mapping work.
Devin (SRE): Per-tenant audit retention is heavy on storage/search. Short-term: export-as-a-service to customer S3 buckets to avoid hot storage costs. Acceptance: export API + scheduled export job + manifest + verification.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Rotation automation target = 1-click rotate + seamless key switch. Perf caveat: runtime caches key ids/metadata; need graceful fallback. Rough estimate: 3w core + 1w e2e tests.
Jules (Legal): Customers will expect documented evidence of rotation and export manifests for SOC2 AOC. Format should be immutable (gzip + sha256) and include signer metadata.
Alex (PM): Proposed ordering: 1) KMS/HSM onboarding (owner Maria + Sam), 2) audit-log export-as-a-service (owner Devin), 3) rotation automation (owner Sam). If we can only deliver two, deprioritize automation and provide a documented manual runbook.
Maria (Security): Agree on ordering. Add acceptance criteria for HSM MVP: vendor integration plugin, per-tenant key metadata storage, integration tests against HSM emulator, and a documented acceptance test scenario.
Devin (SRE): Export MVP should include: PUT /tenants/:id/retention, background export job to S3, signed manifest, and retry semantics. Quick config example: 
```
retention:
  tenant: tenant_123
  days: 365
  export_dest: s3://redwood-audit-tenant-123
```
Sam (Eng Runtime): Failure modes: if export fails >24h, fallback to compressed encrypted local storage and page oncall. Also need strict RBAC on export endpoints + audit trail of who triggered exports.
AuditBot: Note: compliance-ticket #842 created for 'audit-export-mvp' by @Devin
Alex (PM): Tradeoffs/costs: HSM adds monthly vendor fee + more complex Private deployment options. Export-as-a-service increases S3 usage but keeps hot storage cheaper. Rotation automation reduces ops over time but delays initial delivery.
Jules (Legal): Also confirm with Sales which customers actually require HSM in contracts — that'll affect prioritization and willingness to pay.
Maria (Security): :thumbsup: I'll create a pre-sales checklist and map customers with HSM requirements. Can we agree on a launch-criteria doc by EOW?
Sam (Eng Runtime): I'll draft the rotation runbook + failure scenarios by Wed and include rollback steps. @Devin can you take export infra?
Devin (SRE): Yes, I'll own export infra. Prototype ETA: 2 weeks.
Alex (PM): Owners recap: Maria = HSM onboarding; Devin = audit-export; Sam = rotation/runbook. Deliverables by EOW: short PRD for each item + explicit acceptance criteria. If anyone can't meet that, flag here.
Jules (Legal): I'll produce the evidence manifest template (json schema) and share in the working doc.
Maria (Security): Also add an acceptance test: simulated KMS failover with zero data loss observed in logs.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Adding that to test matrix.
Alex (PM): I'll book a 30m working session Thurs 10am PT to finalize launch gates and resource split. If no objections, I'll merge these into the Q3 roadmap after the meeting.
Maria (Security): No objections from me.
Devin (SRE): Sounds good.
Jules (Legal): OK from legal side.
Alex (PM): Thanks all — will drop a calendar invite and a short doc link after this thread.
